analysis_type: CPU-only descriptive audit of existing B0 errors; no training or new propagation data
limitations: Subsampled pixel statistics, not official or full-image validation scores.
Geometry is a bilinear heightmap segment test, not an exact reconstruction of the simulation mesh.
Clearance groups describe direct geometric visibility, not validity masks, true individual path powers or exhaustive LOS/NLOS classification.
Label jumps are diagnostic supervision-side quantities; they are not available as test inputs.
Zeroing a group of observed errors is error accounting, not an achievable model result or an irreducible lower bound.
Two-band correlations do not establish causal attribution; no independent Monte Carlo replicates are available.
